limitations: These are illustrative sensitivity scenarios, not confidence intervals or observed token totals. Actual cost can fall outside the range.
Input includes assumed cumulative prompt and source text across every model turn. Output includes assumed reasoning and generated output. No cache discount is assumed.
Each request is assumed below 272k input tokens. Larger requests, cache writes, regional premiums and different tool billing can change costs.
Session web-tool calls are not equivalent to billed Responses API search calls. The proxy allocates half the shared reviewer calls to each portrait.
Research and adversarial review only. App engineering, orchestration, hosting, storage and other tool costs are excluded. Actual session tokens and billing are not exposed.
